_about: Round 4 VIRAL: the Splash Cam (RingReplay, scripts/ring/ring_replay.gd) and photo mode (PhotoMode, scripts/ui/photo_mode.gd). Every number of the recorder, the replay player, its camera and the photo camera. Words here are the player's: plain, no show words, no words of the genre's big game.
_buffer: The ring buffer: the last buffer_s of every competitor at rec_hz (its skeleton's transform, % and state each tick; its skeleton's final pose every pose_every ticks, each bone's rotation packed to 16 bits a part), up to max_slots competitors, max_props effects in flight (bolts, guards, stones, walls) and max_events events (hits, guards, catches, launches, splashes, clashes). Allocated as each slot is first used; never grows.
_replay: A fall's replay: the last replay_s up to the splash and tail_s after it, started wait_s (real time) after the fall when IMPACT's RingMoment is not there, or as soon as it ends (never later than wait_max_s). slow: the 0.5 s around the decisive hit (the faller's last launch) plays at rate x, eased in and out over ease_s. practice: falls in Practice replay too.
_camera: The replay's side dolly: fov deg, the camera height_m over the pair's middle, the distance that keeps the thrower and the faller in frame with margin_m on each side (min_dist_m .. max_dist_m), drifting dolly_mps along the line between them, eased toward its aim at smooth per second; the faller followed down to the water's height only; look_up_m over the middle.
_highlight: A highlight's snapshot: before_s of the buffer before the play and after_s after it (copied after_s after the play).
_tag: The REPLAY tag in the top-right corner and the skip line under it; a key or button skips once skip_grace_s (real) has passed.

tag.skip: any key: back to the match

_row: The Esc row (RingMenu, from RingReplay.row_text): every, last (only a fall that takes a last life, or sudden death), off. GameSettings section ring, key replays.

row.label: Replays: %s
row.line: See each fall again from the side, slowed at the hit

_photo: Photo mode (Esc, Photo): the free camera's speed (m/s, x fast_mult with Shift), the mouse's turn (rad per pixel), the wheel's FOV step (deg) and its range, the keys, the folder, the wordmark in the corner of saved photos.

photo.row_line: Stop the match, fly the camera, take a picture (saved to your photos folder)
photo.help: WASD move  ·  mouse look  ·  Q / E down / up  ·  wheel zoom  ·  Shift faster  ·  T take  ·  M wordmark %s  ·  Esc back
